why: The Rafael-review refactor, theme T2 (erp-integration-sugar #158, merged into refactor/rafael-review), moves 73 ERP-Core/ERP-Epicor classes into custom/src/Erp under namespace Sugarcrm\Sugarcrm\custom\Erp, autoloaded, deletes the old custom/modules/Quotes/ErpQuoteFacts.php on the tenant (ONEOFF-RemoveErpLeftovers) and ships no class_alias. BdAdmRules asks ERP-Epicor's ErpQuoteFacts for a quote's company and each line's product group. This is a COPY of that namespaced class, laid out as a docroot's custom/src/ so bd_adm_rules_test.php can run the ADM defaults against it through an autoloader, the way Sugar finds it - in CI too, where the sibling repository is not reachable. It is NOT in shared-sugar/PINNED.json: that manifest pins files from the landed Sugar target, and test_shared_fixture_drift.py compares them to the sibling checkout's current path; this file is pinned to one named commit instead, and test_erp_t2_fixture_pin.py compares it to that commit's object wherever the sibling has it.
